description: Search INSPIRE, the high-energy physics literature database run by CERN, DESY, Fermilab, IHEP and SLAC, for papers by topic, author or date, with their arXiv IDs, DOIs and citation counts. List who cites a paper and what it cites, get an author's papers and h-index, export BibTeX, and find institutions, conferences, seminars, jobs, experiments and journals. No account or API key required.
